fields.name: field_0
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x2DF1640 (size 0x10): null handle at +0, byte 0x16 at +8. The server notification system bg3.exe+0x2DF53B0 (message kind 0x30) copies the first qword of the message here. The client side of replication bg3.exe+0x8FB2A0 builds the default {null handle, 0x16} and reads the handle through the entity serializer. Which entity it is (the disarmed weapon or its owner) was not established.

fields.name: Slot
fields.evidence: 1 byte. bg3.exe+0x2DF53B0 copies the byte at +8 of the message; replication bg3.exe+0x8FB2A0 reads exactly one byte into +8. Default 0x16 - the same default as the Slot byte of esv::disarm::WeaponDisarmedEventOneFrameComponent (+0x18), which holds the weapon's EquipableComponent slot.
